summary.text: Location is crucial when investing in Dubai real estate. Understanding a 'money map' is more important than simply focusing on city center or waterfront properties.

summary.text: A mistake in Dubai real estate investment is often due to a weak strategy rather than the area itself. Understanding main roads and future metro lines can help.
